about: Structural defaults every new hotel starts with, taken from what Pallav's own migrations seed and what its code offers when a list is empty. Only structure: shifts, payment modes, plans, contact roles, exit types, ID proof types, expense heads, business units. No real people, phone numbers, e-mails, bank data or Hotel Pallav text. Hotel Pallav's brand names became 'Hotel' and 'Food'.

businessUnits.source: database/migrations/2026_09_18_100001_create_business_units_table.php (Hotel Pallav -> Hotel, Pallav Food -> Food; codes HP/PF -> HOTEL/FOOD)

expenseCategories.source: 2026_09_21_100000_create_expense_catalog_and_lines.php: the expense heads of Master Data became the first categories of each business, with no items (nothing invented); heads from 2026_09_18_120001_create_option_sets_table.php

payrollCompanies.source: app/Models/PayrollCompany.php FIXED (FixedCompaniesTest): exactly two rows in this order, named after the hotel (the hotel name is passed to the seed run as @hotel_name by create-hotel and by `seed`); the CODES are business logic (HP01 pays the staff-meal charge, PF01 is the food provider) and are the same in every hotel

appSettings.source: MJ decision #19 (GST at check-out): the percent used at check-out is read from these two settings and stored with the stay and the bill (pms_stays and bill_master_bills hotel_gst_percent / food_gst_percent)

singletonRows.source: Pallav creates these rows on first use (Site\Settings::current(), PageContent::current()); here they exist from the start, with only the column defaults

notSeeded: revenue_source and expense_head option sets: retired by Pallav (replaced by the reason column and the expense catalogue)
the Hotel Pallav and Pallav Food payroll companies, their bank details, signatories and letters: real company data
meal plan rates and food charge rates: Pallav's own prices (Pallav seeds none)
attendance statuses and deductions: created per payroll company
accounting years: the hotel opens its first year at setup
